exposure: International Classification of Diseases, Ninth Revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-9) codes for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: 35,614 women who underwent Cesarean delivery at Kaiser Permanente Northern California facilities between 2010 and 2013
finding: The study found that ICD-9 codes for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) have high specificity, moderately high positive and negative predictive values, and low sensitivity when compared to estimated blood loss (EBL).
